# A09 requests

Nothing in `server/contracts/` was changed. These are the changes A09 needs from others, with what A09 does meanwhile.

## 1. A08: wire Telegram `/learning <skill>`

The brief says the owner can mark a gap as `learning` from Telegram. The command router (`server/notify/commands.ts`) is A08's and has no extension point.

- Add `learning` to `COMMANDS` and `HELP` (`/learning <skill>`: start learning a skill; `/learning` alone lists them).
- Handler: `(await import('../learning/index.ts')).learningCommand(args)` returns the reply text. It marks the skill `learning` (adding it when new) through A03's learning list, and never demotes anything.
- Meanwhile: the same action is `POST /api/learning/list/start { skill }`.

## 2. A08: show inbox drafts and held mail in the digest

The brief wants recruiter-question replies "queued for the owner in the digest". The digest is A08's (`server/campaign/digest.ts`). Please add to its inbox section:

- Drafted replies waiting for the owner: `inbox_messages` rows with `class = 'recruiter_question'` and `json_extract(data, '$.draft.status') = 'queued'`. Show `data.company`, `data.summary` and `data.draft.to`. The draft body is in `data.draft.body`.
- Questions the answer bank could not answer: `data.unanswered` (string array). A09 also files them as unknown questions through A03's `recordUnknown`, so they already reach Telegram via `pushQuestions`.
- Suspicious mail held for review: `json_extract(data, '$.suspicious') = 1`. Show the count only.

Meanwhile: the drafts are listed at `GET /api/inbox/drafts`, and each one triggers an `info` notification when it is created.

## 3. Lead: `fence()` should also neutralise `<email_message>` (done by the lead)

Resolved: `fence()` now defuses every tag-like sequence. `fenceMail()` stays as a harmless second layer.

`server/ai/prompts.ts` `fence()` neutralises our other data tags but not the one A09 wraps email in. A09 uses a local `fenceMail()` (in `server/inbox/ai.ts`) that calls `fence()` and then neutralises `email_message`. Adding `email_message` to the regex in `fence()` would let A09 drop the local wrapper. Prompt hashes would not change, because the output is identical.

## 4. Lead / A03: optional `hiringContact.email` in `ResearchBrief`

The brief allows follow-ups to "a known hiring contact email published in the posting or on the company's own site". `ResearchBriefSchema.hiringContact` has a name and role but no email, so A09 can only use addresses that appear in the posting text: `jobs.apply_email` or the address we applied to, re-checked with `emailInText()`, or an address on the employer's own domain written in the posting.

Proposal: add `email: z.string().nullable().optional()` to `hiringContact`. A03 should fill it only from the company's own pages. A09 would then accept it when its domain matches the company's domain.

## 5. Contract note: `buildLearningPlan` takes an optional third argument

`buildLearningPlan(applicationId, interviewDate?, opts?: { startAt?: string; force?: boolean })`. The stub's two-argument signature is unchanged and still works. `startAt` makes the plan length deterministic: the inbox passes the email's date. If you want the contract doc to show this, update §4 of `02-CONTRACTS.md`.

## 6. A05: calling `waitForCode`

- `waitForCode(domainOrUrl, timeoutMs)` takes a bare domain, a host or a full URL. For ATS hosts, pass something that carries the tenant: `bluefin.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com`, `https://boards.greenhouse.io/northwindlabs/...` or `jobs.ashbyhq.com/tallgrass`. A shared host alone matches any tenant of that ATS.
- It resolves with the code, or with the verification link when the email has no code (a magic link starts with `https://`). It resolves `null` on timeout.
- Each code is handed out once. A code that arrived up to 5 minutes before the call still counts. Codes expire 15 minutes after Bureau sees them.
- While anyone is waiting, the mailbox is polled every 15 s, or watched with IMAP IDLE when the server supports it.

## 7. A04: `draftFollowUp` and `outcomes`

- A09 calls `draftFollowUp(applicationId)` only after these checks pass: the follow-up is due, the hiring contact is published, there was no reply and no rejection, the daily cap has room, and the kill switch is off. A09 sends the result as-is, trimmed to 150 characters for the subject and 2,000 for the body. Return `null` to decline, and A09 will not retry that application. `NotImplemented` means "no follow-ups today".
- `outcomes.reply_class` is the furthest reply so far (`offer` > `interview_invite` > `assessment` > `recruiter_question` > `rejection`). `days_to_reply` counts to the first reply. Applications sent 21 or more days ago with no reply get `replied = 0`. A later reply flips that row to 1.

## 8. A10: screens

The routes are listed in `docs/build/reports/A09.md`:

- Inbox: list and filter, review queue, unlinked mail, owner corrections, drafts, follow-ups.
- Mailbox settings, with a test-connection button.
- Learning plans, linked from alerts at `/learning/plans/:id`, and gap reports.
- Learning-list status buttons.

Alerts deep-link to `/learning/plans/<id>` and `/inbox/<messageId>`. Set `BUREAU_PUBLIC_URL` to make those links reachable from a phone.
